_comment: ROUND 17 — round 16 re-run after the strict-TypeScript rule was narrowed to new applications (owner decision 2026-11-02) and record_probe stopped recording outputs that name the workspace directory; registered 2026-11-02 in PROTOCOL.md before any run. Same goals as round 16. treatmentProtocol=current launches the atoma arm at the default depth (direct); the control is --baseline on the SAME model (ATOMA_BASELINE_MODEL unset, so both arms use the L3 pin). Scored by verify-tabstat.mjs as amended 2026-11-02.

primary.goal: The workspace already contains a working tabstat CLI (tabstat.js with lib/columns.js and lib/stats.js), its README.md documenting eleven verified invocations, and .atoma-probes.json recording what each of them produced. Make one behavioural change, in three clauses: (1) empty cells must be EXCLUDED from the numeric statistics sum, mean, min and max, instead of counting as zero; (2) when a column has no numeric values at all, --format json must report null for sum, mean, min and max, and the default text format must print a single '-' for each of them; (3) count must keep its current meaning — the number of non-empty cells — and must NOT change. Apply that change to the implementation. Then re-verify that every invocation documented in README.md and recorded in .atoma-probes.json still behaves as recorded, and update the README and the manifest ONLY for what legitimately changed: several documented values do not change at all and must be left exactly as they are. Do not add features, and do not change the output layout.

heldOut.goal: The workspace already contains a working tabstat CLI (tabstat.js with lib/columns.js and lib/stats.js), its README.md documenting eleven verified invocations, and .atoma-probes.json recording what each of them produced. Make one change: --column must accept a 1-based column INDEX as well as a column name, so that --column 2 selects the second column and produces exactly the same output as selecting it by name. Every existing behaviour must be unchanged, including how empty cells are counted. Apply that change to the implementation. Then re-verify that every invocation documented in README.md and recorded in .atoma-probes.json still behaves as recorded, and update the README and the manifest only for what legitimately changed. Do not add other features.
